Indian Companies Report Mixed Q1 Earnings Amidst Cost Pressures

Several Indian companies have released their first-quarter financial results for FY27, showing varied performance. Ashok Leyland reported record earnings but faced squeezed margins due to higher costs, while maintaining investment plans and deploying AI for productivity. Black Box saw its profit rise 18% to ₹55.9 crore on a 24% revenue jump. Max Healthcare, JSW Cement, Honasa Consumer, and LG Electronics India also reported profit increases. However, The Economic Times noted a contrasting trend in US markets with Tapestry forecasting weak annual sales for Kate Spade.
